title: LeMonde Newsletter Problem
summary: Hi, I’m really happy with how Newsblur ingests and formats newsletters in general (aside from some image sizing issues here and there) but one newsletter I came across with a big rendering problem is the LeMonde English’s daily newsletters. I’m not sure what goes wrong but I’m attaching a screenshot from my browser as an example. It looks same on iOS, iPadOS and macOS apps as well. Samuel, if you need anything else from me to figure out the problem just let me know.
body_markdown:
Hi, I’m really happy with how Newsblur ingests and formats newsletters in general (aside from some image sizing issues here and there) but one newsletter I came across with a big rendering problem is the LeMonde English’s daily newsletters. I’m not sure what goes wrong but I’m attaching a screenshot from my browser as an example. It looks same on iOS, iPadOS and macOS apps as well.


[Screenshot 2026-11-21 at 16.31.09 1920×1041 309 KB](https://forum.newsblur.com/uploads/default/original/2X/6/630c8549ef4a9e8216355175616a2b0e7f217551.jpeg)


Samuel, if you need anything else from me to figure out the problem just let me know.
